title: No open burning of biomass or municipal solid waste
rule_text: From Stage I onwards, open burning of biomass and municipal solid waste is prohibited across NCR, and agencies must make sure there are no fires at landfill sites and dumpsites.
source: CAQM GRAP Stage I actions (revised schedule approved 28 Sep 2026); CAQM Stage I invocation press release, 16 Apr 2026

title: Dust control at construction and demolition sites
rule_text: From Stage I onwards, construction and demolition sites must follow the dust mitigation rules and guidelines, including covering of exposed material and use of anti-smog guns in proportion to the construction area of the project.
source: CAQM GRAP Stage I actions (revised schedule approved 28 Sep 2026); CAQM Stage I invocation press release, 16 Apr 2026

title: No dumping of construction or municipal waste on open land
rule_text: From Stage I onwards, municipal solid waste and construction and demolition waste must be lifted regularly and taken to designated sites, and must not be dumped illegally on open land.
source: CAQM GRAP Stage I actions (revised schedule approved 28 Sep 2026); CAQM Stage I invocation press release, 16 Apr 2026

title: Construction material and debris must be covered in transit
rule_text: Under the construction and demolition dust mitigation measures that GRAP Stage I requires to be enforced, vehicles carrying construction material or debris must keep the load covered so dust does not escape on the road.
source: Dust mitigation measures for C&D activities, enforced under CAQM GRAP Stage I. VERIFY exact wording in the C&D dust mitigation guidelines before the demo.

title: Construction and demolition activity restricted
rule_text: At Stage III, most construction and demolition activity across NCR is stopped, apart from exempted categories such as essential public projects. Dust-raising work seen at a non-exempt site during Stage III is a violation on top of the Stage I dust rules.
source: CAQM GRAP Stage III actions. VERIFY the exemption list in the revised schedule approved 28 Sep 2026 before the demo.
